tools.name: visarun_get_application
tools.description: Use this when someone asks where one application stands: 'what is the status of my Dubai visa', 'ما حالة تأشيرتي لدبي؟', 'какой статус у моей визы в Таиланд', 'मेरे थाईलैंड वीज़ा की स्थिति क्या है?'. Status, completion, payment state and trip of one application, with the UI link to open it in the br

tools.name: visarun_get_application_fields
tools.description: The questionnaire of an application as data, in two parts. documents: each file to upload with its status (missing, reading, read, failed, uploaded) and, once read, what it read in answer keys (files[].read.answers, with confirmed_by_mrz naming the values the passport's check digits confirm); a pass

tools.name: visarun_get_field_options
tools.description: The full value list of one select field (when the fields call truncated it). answers supplies the parent values a dependent list needs.

tools.name: visarun_list_documents
tools.description: Files linked to an application, as the questionnaire lists them. What their reading found is in visarun_validate_application.

tools.name: visarun_validate_application
tools.description: What submit will say right now: missing or invalid answers per step, document problems, warnings. ready_to_submit true means submit will go through (payment aside); a FILED_BY_SPECIALIST warning means it goes to a Visarun specialist who files it by hand, as the automation does not file these answers

tools.name: visarun_run_mira_check
tools.description: A deep check of the application by Mira, Visarun's application checker, the one Validate runs in the app, up to two minutes: contradictions between the answers, the documents, the trip and the chat that no rule catches, and corrections already checked against each field's rules. It changes no answer

tools.name: visarun_call_specialist
tools.description: Sends the person's question to a Visarun visa specialist, who answers in the application: visarun_get_application lists the questions and answers. Only a submitted application has a specialist queue, and one question waits at a time: otherwise nothing is sent (sent: false, with the reason). whatsapp

tools.name: visarun_get_requirements
tools.description: The tourist or short-term business visa requirements for a destination, from the table Mira reads: documents, processing time, fees and the official page they come from (source). They are general, not checked against a nationality: whether the person needs a visa at all is visarun_check_eligibility'

After submission: how it was filed (filing: government, an acknowledgement from the government; form_delivered

tools.description: Group trips the account can see.

tools.description: One trip with its travellers' applications.

tools.name: visarun_list_trip_documents
tools.description: Shared files of a trip (hotel booking, sponsor statement) that apply to every traveller.

tools.name: visarun_create_trip
tools.description: A group trip. travellers[] creates one draft application per traveller in the same call. Creates records; call once per trip.

tools.description: Puts an existing application into a trip. Same effect when repeated.

tools.name: visarun_save_answers
tools.description: Merges answers into the application's questionnaire (keys from get_application_fields). A select takes an option's value or label, a checkbox true or false, a date YYYY-MM-DD; normalized lists what was converted. tools.description: One shared file for the whole trip (hotel booking, invitation, sponsor statement). The file the person attached in this chat goes in file (at most 10 MB).

Refused with 422 while answers are missing or invalid, 402 until the account holder pays on the application's page in the app (links.ui of

tools.name: visarun_list_events
tools.description: What happened since a cursor: applications created, status changes, documents linked, payments, submissions and the government's decisions, oldest first. Pass next_cursor back as since. With application_id, one application's events; without, the organization's (owners and admins).

tools.name: visarun_get_application_history
tools.description: Every version of the application's answers: who changed them (a person, Mira, OCR, an organization default) and when.

tools.name: visarun_list_application_access
tools.description: The people the application is shared with, and whether they may view or edit it.

tools.name: visarun_share_application
tools.description: Gives a person access to the application by email, to view or to edit; they see it in Visarun when they sign in. No email is sent. Ask the human before sharing.

tools.name: visarun_delete_application
tools.description: Moves the application to the deleted list. Owners and admins of the organization delete any; a manager their assigned clients'; a member or a manager an application they own until it is submitted or paid. tools.name: visarun_duplicate_application
tools.description: A new draft with the same answers and documents, for the next traveller or the next trip. Creates a record; call once per copy.

tools.name: visarun_list_members
tools.description: The organization's members and their roles.

tools.name: visarun_invite_member
tools.description: Invites a person to the organization by email with a role. Only they receive the link to join, by email; email_sent says whether it went out (if not, an owner or admin resends it from the Team page in Visarun). Ask the human before inviting.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: visarun_check_eligibility, visarun_run_mira_check, visarun_upload_document, visarun_create_upload_page, visarun_share_application, visarun_invite_member · Private data: visarun_whoami, visarun_check_eligibility, visarun_list_destinations, visarun_get_application_fields, visarun_list_documents, visarun_validate_application, visarun_run_mira_check, visarun_get_requirements, visarun_get_result, visarun_list_trip_documents, visarun_create_trip, visarun_create_application, visarun_save_answers, visarun_upload_document, visarun_create_upload_link, visarun_create_upload_page, visarun_upload_trip_document, visarun_submit_application, visarun_list_events, visarun_duplicate_application · Public sink: visarun_check_eligibility, visarun_get_application_fields, visarun_validate_application, visarun_upload_document, visarun_create_upload_link, visarun_create_upload_page, visarun_upload_trip_document, visarun_submit_application, visarun_share_application, visarun_invite_member · Destructive: visarun_run_mira_check, visarun_create_upload_link, visarun_submit_application, visarun_delete_application.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
